Select compounds with exact IC50 measurements against human 5-lipoxygenase. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs, compound_records, and compound_structures. Filter for standard_type IC50, standard_relation equals, standard_units nM, and target name 5-lipoxygenase with organism Homo sapiens. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
